_comment: Authored layer, overlaid onto the auto-derived keyword history by generate.py. Hand-authored facts ONLY: value grammars (LATEST release, v4.8.7), defaults, required-ness, one-line summaries, deprecation/rename notes. Source-derivable facts (keyword set, context, introduced_in, present_in) come from scanning the release tags -- do not repeat them here. Grammars authored against v4.8.7 src/cfile.c parse_* functions + the inline load_cfile dispatch. Symbols (bpp-manual Table 1): b=0/1, d=integer, +d=non-negative integer, f=float, s=string, t=Newick tree, x*=list of >=1 of type x, [x]=optional. Complex keywords (clock/locusrate/heredity/migration/finetune) carry the top-level grammar shape plus a 'detail' note; full nested formalisation is a later refinement.

flags.int: invgamma only: integrate theta analytically out of the likelihood (v4.8.2+); 'e'/'E' is accepted as a backward-compat no-op

thetaprior.summary: Prior on theta (population size); invgamma (default) or gamma.

value_history.note: A 'beta p q l u' theta prior existed in v4.4.0-v4.7.0 (THETA_PRIOR enum max=3) and was removed in v4.8.0 (enum max=2). No direct replacement; use invgamma or gamma. bpp-lint should flag 'thetaprior = beta ...' in old control files.

Before v4.8.2 the inverse-gamma prior integrated theta out by default and a trailing 'e' switched to estimation. Since v4.8.2 estimation is the default and analytical integration is requested with the 'int' keyword; 'e'/'E' is still parsed but is a no-op.

tauprior.required_when: species count > 1 (single-species analyses have no divergence times)
tauprior.summary: Prior on tau (divergence times); invgamma (default) or gamma.

phiprior.required_when: species&tree has an MSC-I introgression node (&phi=)
phiprior.summary: Beta(a,b) prior on phi (introgression probability); no distribution keyword.

wprior.summary: Gamma prior on migration rate w (MSC-M). Replaces migprior (v4.8.0).

alphaprior.summary: Gamma prior for among-site rate variation; optional 3rd value = number of rate categories (default 4).

jobname.summary: Output filename prefix (no extension). Replaces outfile/mcmcfile (v4.8.0).

datefile.summary: Tip-dating file of sequence sampling dates.

constraintfile.summary: File of topological constraints on the species tree.

traitfile.summary: Morphological/quantitative trait data file (iBPP trait analysis).

value.notes: -1 draws a fresh seed from the system

seed.summary: Random-number seed; -1 = draw a random seed.

value.notes: 0 means use all loci in seqfile

nloci.summary: Number of loci to analyse (0 = all).

nsample.summary: Number of MCMC samples to collect.

value.notes: 0=prior only, 1=use data, 2=use data with fixed gene trees

usedata.summary: Whether the sequence likelihood is used.

cleandata.summary: Remove sites with ambiguities/gaps before analysis.

scaling.summary: Scale conditional likelihoods to avoid numerical underflow.

threads.summary: Number of threads, with optional starting core index and step.

checkpoint.summary: Write a checkpoint at iteration `initial`, then every `step` iterations.

value.notes: count followed by that many locus indices

printlocus.summary: Print per-locus gene trees for the listed loci.

bayesfactorbeta.summary: Power-posterior beta for marginal-likelihood (Bayes factor) estimation.

value.notes: 5 bits: samples, locusrate, heredity/hscalars, genetrees, [qmatrix]; first bit must be 1; -1 = summary only

print.summary: Which MCMC quantities to write; first bit (MCMC samples) must be 1.

value.notes: one 0/1 per species (1 = unphased diploid, needs resolving)

arch.summary: Force a SIMD instruction set (default: auto-detect).

thetamodel.summary: How theta parameters are shared across populations.

loadbalance.summary: Thread work-distribution strategy. NOTE: source default is 'zigzag'; the manual says 'none'.

value.detail: clock id (1=strict/global, 2/3=relaxed); relaxed clocks add rate-prior parameters. See parse_clock.
0=none; 1=estimate with a gamma/dirichlet prior (mubar params + prior keyword); or a filename of fixed per-locus rates. See parse_locusrate.
0=none; 1=estimate with a gamma prior (alpha beta); or a filename of fixed per-locus heredity multipliers. See parse_heredity.

heredity.summary: Per-locus heredity multipliers (e.g. autosome vs. sex chromosome).

value.detail: leading 0/1 auto-reset flag, then optional step sizes for the MCMC proposals. See parse_finetune.

finetune.summary: MCMC proposal step sizes; leading bit enables auto-tuning.

value.detail: count N, then N lines each naming a source and destination population (MSC-M migration band), optionally with rate parameters. Multi-line; parsed via parse_migration. Requires wprior.
value.context_note: mutually exclusive with introgression (&phi= in species&tree)

value.notes: count K, then K species names, then K per-species sequence counts, then the guide-tree Newick (or a bare label for 1 species)

species&tree.summary: Species count, names, per-species sample counts, and the guide tree.

value.notes: est (0/1); if 1: rjMCMC algorithm (0 or 1) then its finetune params -- algorithm 0 takes one (epsilon): '1 0 e'; algorithm 1 takes two (alpha m): '1 1 a m'
estimate switch (0/1); if 1, may be followed by up to 4 SPR/SNL proposal tuning floats (e.g. 'pSlider ExpandRatio ShrinkRatio'), which parse_speciestree reads best-effort

speciestree.summary: Species-tree estimation switch + optional move tuning (A01/A11).

speciesmodelprior.required_when: recommended explicit when speciesdelimitation=1 or speciestree=1 (bpp-lint BPP101); the source otherwise defaults to 1 (BPP_SPECIES_PRIOR_UNIFORM)
speciesmodelprior.summary: Prior on species models; integer 0-3, default 1 (uniform rooted).

outfile.note: v4.8.7 parser aborts on 'outfile'; use jobname (outfile/mcmcfile merged into jobname in 4.8.0).

mcmcfile.note: v4.8.7 parser aborts on 'mcmcfile'; use jobname.

diploid.note: v4.8.7 parser aborts on 'diploid' with a rename message; use phase (same syntax).

migprior.note: Reparameterised, not a pure rename: wprior uses w = 4M/theta, so numeric values must be re-derived from your theta scale. v4.8.7 parser aborts on 'migprior'.

sequenceerror.note: Recognised by the parser but aborts at runtime ('Not implemented'); a dead BPP 3.x keyword. bpp-lint flags this (BPP023).

keywords._sim_comment: Simulation-only keywords (--simulate control file, parsed by cfile_sim.c). Value grammars authored against v4.8.7.

value.grammar: (0|1) f f f f f f
value.notes: leading switch 0=variable (Dirichlet prior), 1=fixed; then 6 exchangeabilities for TC TA TG CA CG AG

qrates.summary: GTR exchangeability rates to simulate under (--simulate only).

value.notes: leading switch 0=variable, 1=fixed; then 4 base frequencies T C A G

basefreqs.summary: GTR base frequencies to simulate under (--simulate only).

loci&length.summary: Number of loci and sites per locus to simulate (--simulate).

treefile.summary: Output file for the simulated trees (--simulate).

concatfile.summary: Output file for the concatenated alignment (--simulate).

modelparafile.summary: Output file for per-locus model parameters (--simulate).

seqerr.summary: Sequencing-error model to simulate: read depth plus base-error and two Dirichlet concentration parameters (--simulate).

seqDates.summary: Sequence sampling-dates file, the --simulate analogue of datefile.

value.notes: 0=variable: gamma(alpha,beta) prior over ncat categories; 1=fixed: gamma shape alpha

alpha_locusrate.note: Valid in v4.1.x; since v4.2.1 the --simulate parser aborts telling you to use 'locusrate' (new multi-argument syntax). The keyword is still tokenised in every release, but only to emit that error -- so the auto-derived 'present_in' does NOT mean it is usable.

keywords._legacy_comment: Authored legacy keywords that predate the scanned release tags (< v4.1.3) or were never in mainline BPP (iBPP). They have no auto-derived history; consumers use status/superseded_by. Kept in sync with bpp-lint src/keywords.c.

uniformrootedtrees.note: BPP 3.x keyword; integer values map directly to speciesmodelprior. Predates the scanned tags.

gammaprior.note: Beta(a,b) prior on phi; renamed to phiprior in v4.1.1 (before the earliest scanned tag v4.1.3).

ntraits.note: iBPP-specific (combined trait/sequence analysis); not in mainline BPP.
